title: FIGMA - Party role (Assign a new party role)
walkthroughSteps: Navigate to /fnol/parties — a policy is pre-selected so the step doesn't redirect to search

walkthroughSteps.title: Party role
walkthroughSteps.body: Every party row has an actions menu with View details, Edit role, and Remove.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Opens the row's action menu — Edit role is where a party's role assignment changes.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every party row has an Edit role action
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Each party on the FNOL Parties step has an actions menu including **Edit role**, for assigning or changing that party's role.

setup.description: Seed a selected policy so /fnol/parties doesn't redirect to /fnol/search

preconditions.text: At least one party row with an Edit role action is visible

expectedUI.description: Party row actions menu with Edit role
visualCues: Kebab action button per party row
Menu includes View details, Edit role, Remove

howToTest.trigger: Click a party row's actions kebab
howToTest.expectedResult: Menu opens with Edit role available
